references.text: Psalm 18:25-26 speaks of how God treats people according to their purity and conduct, which reflects the idea of mercy in Matthew 5:7.
Proverbs 3:3 encourages not letting love and faithfulness depart from you, which can be seen as a parallel to showing mercy.
Hebrews 6:10 emphasizes the importance of showing mercy to receive mercy, which directly corresponds with Matthew 5:7.
James 2:13 speaks of how mercy triumphs over judgment, which aligns with the principle of receiving mercy by being merciful as mentioned in Matthew 5:7.
